name: cowsay
purpose: Display a text message inside an ASCII-art speech bubble (cow, dragon, tux).
explanation: Demonstrates two key C03 concepts: (1) why non-built-in commands fail with `command not found` until installed via Homebrew (`brew install cowsay`), and (2) Command + Option (`-f`) + Argument structure.

parameters.description: Selects the ASCII character (e.g. dragon, tux).

explanationOfOutput: Prints the message wrapped in an ASCII bubble above the chosen character.
whenToUse: To practise command flags (`-f`) and piping (`fortune | cowsay | lolcat`).
commonMistakes: Running `cowsay` before installing it with `brew install cowsay`.
